summary: GET /api/tags (client API) looked up the details of a role's first model with an unconditional dict index on the node returned by scheduler.any_online_node_with. That node may offer the model only through a switch to its standby Ollama (Node.standby_switch), whose models have no entry in model_details, so the listing answered 500 for every client. The lookup now falls back to the existing placeholder details (digest router-<role>, size 0, empty details), the same output as for a role whose model no online node has. The response shape, the authentication and authorization of the route, the set of listed roles and the concrete-model listing are unchanged; no new route, port, credential, network destination or logged value. Router version 0.30.0 -> 0.30.1.

findings.evidence: The failure path ran through the last-resort error middleware (fixed 500 with a reference, exception logged without its message).
findings.resolution: Pre-existing and unchanged: the fix removes this occurrence of the error path; the middleware and its logging are not touched.

tests.command: python test/selftest_standby_switch.py (new check 2b before the fix)
tests.evidence: Without the proxy.py change the new check raises KeyError: 'example-dense:27b' in tags_list, the same error as reported in operation.
control flow ok: 0 legacy findings in 0 files (baseline)

limitations: The placeholder details carry no size or family for a standby-only model; clients that read them see the same values as for a role without an online node.
Not yet verified against the running router; that follows the operator's deployment of 0.30.1.
